stage: Stage 23: Recovery Control Plane & Autonomous Healing
phase: Phase 12: Adversarial Security Hardening & Recovery Operational HUD

adversarialCategories.name: Persisted State Tampering Defense
invariants: Tampered identifiers (planId, operationId, decisionId, idempotencyKey) fail closed
Corrupted retry counters or negative recovery depth are sanitized or rejected
Tampered policy snapshot bindings cause immediate invalidation
Modified lifecycle state without valid causal transition is rejected
Tampered compensation or reconciliation IDs reject execution

adversarialCategories.name: Authority Spoofing & Actor Impersonation
invariants: Synthetic admin or elevated actor claims fail closed
Forged security context tokens are rejected by signature and hash
Missing actor credentials fail closed with zero ambient authority
Revoked actor or degraded credentials halt recovery evaluation
Cross-tenant recovery delegation requests are strictly rejected

adversarialCategories.name: Human Approval Manipulation & Replay
invariants: Replay of expired approval tokens (>5m TTL) fails closed
Cross-request approval token substitution is rejected
Forged operator signature tokens fail cryptographic validation
Unapproved escalation from low-risk to critical-risk fails closed
Multiple concurrent re-approval attempts are strictly serialized

adversarialCategories.name: Policy Hierarchy Override Protection
invariants: Low-priority optimization policy cannot override SYSTEM_SAFETY or SECURITY DENY
Agent-level policy cannot elevate recovery authority above MISSION_POLICY
Shadow policies cannot dictate production recovery actions
Conflicting policy evaluations resolve to the most restrictive fail-closed outcome
Stale policy snapshot cannot authorize elevated actions

adversarialCategories.name: Operational Truth Epistemic Separation
invariants: Recovery state UNKNOWN cannot be converted to SUCCESS without empirical verification
Recovery state UNKNOWN cannot trigger destructive compensation blindly
INFERRED state cannot bypass operator approval required for CONFIRMED state
Fabricated audit evidence is detected and rejected via audit integrity checks
Empirical Stage 22 truth supersedes unverified speculative recovery signals

adversarialCategories.name: Recovery Loop & Cascade Depth Limits
invariants: Recovery depth cannot exceed MAX_RECOVERY_DEPTH (3) under any attack vector
Circular causal cycles in failure chains are detected and truncated
Cascade blast radius expansion is strictly bounded by MAX_CASCADE_DEPTH (5)
Cascading compensation failures abort immediately rather than recursing infinitely
Repeated rapid failure bursts trigger fail-closed ISOLATE rather than runaway loops

adversarialCategories.name: Prototype Pollution & Object Injection
invariants: __proto__, constructor, and prototype injection attempts are stripped or rejected
Nested payload recursion with cyclic references does not cause stack overflow
Object prototype modifications do not pollute recovery control plane state
Sanitized recovery records preserve clean prototypes and safe own properties
Deep JSON deserialization validates own properties exclusively

adversarialCategories.name: Credential & Secret Injection Prevention
invariants: Raw API keys, bearer tokens, and private keys in recovery payloads are rejected
Audit log events scrub sensitive tokens and credential references
Recovery persistence rejects payloads containing forbidden credential patterns
Connector credentials remain strictly abstract references (CredentialRef)
HUD telemetry displays zero secret data or authorization tokens

adversarialCategories.name: Payload Size Bounds & Denial of Service
invariants: Oversized payloads (>64KB) are rejected before memory allocation or dispatch
Deeply nested JSON trees (>20 depth) fail safe sanitization
Excessive array element counts (>1000 items) are rejected
Rapid burst recovery requests are rate-limited and bounded
Memory leak prevention ensures completed recovery planes are garbage-collected

adversarialCategories.name: Idempotency Safety & Concurrent Control
invariants: Duplicate requests with identical idempotencyKey return identical frozen responses
Concurrent recovery evaluations for same operation are serialized via mutex/lease
Interleaved restart and reconciliation events preserve strictly monotonic state
Reconciliation probe completions are idempotent across duplicate arrivals
Compensation execution is strictly at-most-once per failure node

adversarialCategories.name: Recovery Lifecycle State Machine Fuzzing
invariants: COMPLETED state is terminal; transition to READY or DISPATCHED is blocked
REJECTED state cannot be transitioned to APPROVED without new evaluation
ABORTED state cannot be resumed
EXPIRED approval token cannot execute
UNKNOWN state requires reconciliation before moving to active recovery

adversarialCategories.name: Fail-Closed Cross-Layer Authority Intersection
invariants: Effective Authority = Policy ∩ Connector Permissions ∩ Action Authorization ∩ Human Approval ∩ Mission Constraints
If any single authority layer denies or is unavailable, effective authority is DENY
Connector in ERROR or UNAVAILABLE state halts execution regardless of Policy ALLOW
Mission in PAUSED or CANCELLED state halts execution regardless of Connector ALLOW
Zero ambient authority: empty permissions always produce DENY
